What qualified means

Less “How much?” More useful context.

We are not building a list that sprays the same inquiry at twenty businesses. A qualified introduction should tell you enough to make a fast, informed decision about whether the opportunity fits.

  • Matched to your category, service area, minimums, and lead time
  • Customer has consented to be contacted about the event
  • Budget and expectations are stated before you prepare a quote
  • You may decline without penalty or pressure

More than a directory listing

We help customers recognize the artist—not just compare prices.

Your profile is built with you, not scraped from the internet. We shape the page around what makes your work distinct, then ask you to approve every public detail and supplied image before publication.

The goal is not to make every vendor look interchangeable. It is to help the right customer understand why your work is the right fit.

Founding artisan onboarding

A human process before a heavy marketplace.

We start with fit, clarity, and consent. Accounts and dashboards can wait until the relationship proves useful.

  1. 01Apply

    Share your categories, service area, work samples, minimums, and contact preferences.

  2. 02Fit review

    We review presentation, reliability, event readiness, and whether the network adds genuine value.

  3. 03Short conversation

    We confirm capacity, ideal events, boundaries, lead time, and what a useful opportunity looks like.

  4. 04Profile build

    We prepare the public story and operating details; you approve everything before it appears.

  5. 05Pilot introductions

    Matched opportunities arrive individually with context. You choose whether to quote.

  6. 06Review the evidence

    We examine introductions, quotes, bookings, revenue, and time saved before discussing paid participation.

Transparent economics

We should earn a commission only where we create value.

Founding profiles are free. The validation period remains commission-free until the artisan has completed 90 days and received at least three qualified OAE introductions. Paid participation begins only after a review and explicit opt-in.

5%

Discovery referral

OAE introduces the customer and the artisan handles qualification, quoting, and coordination.

10%

Qualified opportunity

OAE verifies fit, collects the event brief, and routes a customer prepared to consider a quote.

15%

Concierge coordination

OAE qualifies the request and coordinates the moving pieces around a multi-vendor event.

The guardrails: No fees on customers you already own. No fee merely for being listed. Commission applies only to completed OAE-originated bookings under terms agreed before the paid period begins.
